cleanTitle: Mother's Day is Satanic. READ your BIBLE!
segments: The world say every May celebrate
Mother's Day. But stop and ask yourself,
is that really of God? When a woman
praises Jesus' mother, listen to his
reply. Blessed is the womb that bear
thee, and the paps which thou hast
sucked. But he said, "Yay, rather,
blessed are they that hear the word of
God and keep it." Jesus didn't lift up
his mother or tradition. He pointed them
back to the word of God. But how do you
supposed to honor your mother? Let's
read it out of the Bible and see.
Proverbs 18. My son, hear the
instruction of thy father and forsake
not the law of thy mother. Even King
Solomon listened to the instructions
that his mother taught him. Proverbs
3:1, the words of King Lemule, the
prophecy that his mother taught him. So
instead of celebrating Mother's Day,
come and learn how to honor thy mother
and thy father at IUIC. Austin.
